onset.Description: Onset of the event, measured from the beginning of the acquisition.

duration.Description: Duration of the event (measured from onset).

is_vis.Description: whether the trial was a visually guided trial (True: visually guided, False: non-visually guided)

is_ruleA.Description: whether the trial happened during rule A (True: rule A (BL,WR), False: rule B(WL,BR))

is_switch.Description: whether a rule switch happened on the trial (True: switch, False: non-switch)

is_cueB.Description: whether the trial had a black cue (True: black, False: white)

is_choL.Description: whether the mouse made a left choice on the trial (True: left, False: right)

is_correct.Description: whether the trial was correct (True: correct, False: incorrect)

association_mat.Description: behavioral LSTM predicted conditional probability, order: P(R|W), P(L|W), P(R|B), P(L|B)

rule_belief.Description: the rule belief on the trial (pos: rule B, neg: rule A)

signed_bias.Description: the singed choice bias on the trial (pos: left bias, neg: right bias)

prob_actual_cho.Description: the probability of actual choice on the trial, i.e. P(actual choice|actual cue)

trial_onset_plane_frame_idx.Description: correspoding imaging frame index for this trial onset for each imaging plane

trial_offset_plane_frame_idx.Description: correspoding imaging frame index for this trial offset for each imaging plane

epoch_type.Description: type of epoch: maze, maze_stem, maze_arm, feedback_delay, feedback, iti, feedback_and_iti

nwb_table.Description: The name of the NWB table from which this event was extracted.

Levels.trials: The 'trials' table in the NWB file.
Levels.epochs: The 'epochs' table in the NWB file.
